model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts from Eurostat illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in the European Union for 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. The first chart, "Number of Enterprises," shows that Other Services account for 61% (19.0 million), followed by Trade at 19% (5.9 million), Construction at 12% (3.7 million), and Industry at 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, "Number of Persons Employed," indicates that Other Services employ the largest share at 51% (80.2 million), followed by Industry at 21% (33.0 million), Trade at 19% (29.5 million), and Construction at 9% (13.4 million). The third chart, "Turnover," reveals that Industry contributes 33% (10.6 trillion euros), Other Services 31% (9.8 trillion euros), Trade 31% (9.9 trillion euros), and Construction 6% (1.9 trillion euros). Each chart uses distinct colors for the sectors—gold for Industry, blue for Construction, red for Trade, and dark blue for Other Services—with percentage and absolute values labeled within each segment. The charts are presented side by side for comparative analysis, and a legend is provided below for color identification.
